opennyai_summary.7_May_2025__decision:
The petitioner seeks bail in anticipation of his arrest in a case registered for the offences punishable under Sections 363, 366(A), 376, 498(A), 323 of the Indian Penal Code, 8 of POCSO Act and under Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
The petitioner and the O.P. No.2 along with the respective learned counsels shall remain physically present before the Mediation Center of the Patna High Court on 18.06.2025, so that the matter is referred to learned mediator for resolving the dispute amicably.
Put up this case on 23.07.2025.
7.
In the meantime, there shall be no coercive action against the petitioner in connection with Bajpatti P.S. Case No.233 of 2024.
